industry_fit.rationale: <cite index="1-11,2-4">Heidelberg USA is the leading supplier to commercial, packaging and label printing companies in North America and manufactures offset printing presses.</cite> <cite index="21-3,21-8">While customers use Versafire digital presses for signage business with synthetics crucial to signage applications,</cite> Heidelberg is primarily an equipment manufacturer selling printing presses to printers, not a sign manufacturer, large-format graphics producer, or vehicle wrap installer that would directly use Tedlar films. The company has limited presence in Tedlar's core target verticals.

size_revenue_fit.rationale: <cite index="2-32">Parent company Heidelberger Druckmaschinen AG generated sales of around €2.4 billion ($2.6B USD) in financial year 2023-2024.</cite> <cite index="13-1,13-2,16-1">Heidelberg USA has approximately 1,000 employees and $430M in annual revenue.</cite> <cite index="12-3">The global Heidelberg organization has roughly 18,000 employees in 170 countries.</cite> This is a large, well-established enterprise significantly exceeding the $100M+ revenue threshold.

strategic_relevance.rationale: Heidelberg's product portfolio focuses on commercial printing presses (Speedmaster offset, Versafire digital, Jetfire) for catalogs, packaging, and labels—not outdoor durable graphics or protective film applications. <cite index="30-1">While Heidelberg added wide-format VUTEk technology for posters, banners, backlit signage and displays,</cite> they sell the equipment to print shops rather than being end-users of protective films. The durability/UV protection value propositions of Tedlar don't align with Heidelberg's core business model as an equipment manufacturer.

market_activity.rationale: <cite index="37-1,40-2">Heidelberg exhibited at drupa 2024 trade fair and unveiled the Jetfire 50 digital press developed with Canon.</cite> <cite index="36-1">The company's 2025 event calendar shows participation in PRINTING United (October 2025 in Orlando) and Eurasia Packaging.</cite> <cite index="34-3,34-5">Despite market challenges, Heidelberg achieved 7.1% adjusted EBITDA margin in FY 2024/25 with expenses for the drupa trade fair.</cite> The company is active in print industry trade shows but not in ISA Sign Expo or FESPA, which are Tedlar's primary target events.

qualification_summary: Heidelberg USA is a poor fit for Tedlar's ICP. While the company is a large, financially strong enterprise with $430M revenue and strong trade show activity, it operates as an equipment manufacturer selling printing presses to commercial printers rather than as a sign fabricator, graphics producer, or vehicle wrap installer. Heidelberg sells the machines that print graphics; they are not end-users of protective overlaminate films like Tedlar for outdoor durability applications. This is a supplier/vendor relationship mismatch—Heidelberg's customers (print shops, sign manufacturers) would be better Tedlar prospects than Heidelberg itself.
